label: Romanisation · the heading
rom: Flenn Seren
english: OF THIS BOOK

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Et syst sullast, ul Hyll Dhumol.
english: *The third summer, in the Tide of Remembering.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re ryt Seren Pa Luth o, ryterd et flennath sy, eth sullast odh Halyna.
english: *By Seren Two-Inks, scribe of this Book, and the third of the hearth of {{Halyna}}.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss domm nasell et surr. Aedh et hellur um gor lern lom, eth re nadhald Odh Sell dem gesketh. Um et hald veskym et movenn ul memmyl, ul helvhoss sa nath hunnom.
english: It is the short dark of the year. The hall sleepeth about me, and the Long Hearth is sunk to coals. On the wall I see the banner lift, in a wind I hear not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss saed et flennath loskat. Hos hy o wrodhardath, sa re wemm nind thenth um gor helvhoss, doss o ul vimm et stelleth rerddhalden tevar. Vess sy re vymmym dem et flenn hosast. Re luskom et flenn pondul, hy vodh nel hosk ul lern ganna.
english: The Book is half full. One of its tellers, that held up a wet finger to every wind, is under the east cairns already. Tonight have I turned back to the first leaf. I left it bare, for the lintel is not cut ere the posts are raised.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo et odh sy re hadhant galdardath hosast et Kethow trenneth. Amm re orrant hy et Kethow, re wrident et trenneth lo et odh. Amm sy resker ul vodh re reskent, amm doss nayalat tul lo et garlath veth so hethyl lo et vorr.
english: At this hearth the first builders of the Keep laid their tales. When the Keep was left, the tales went cold with the hearth. Now sit we where they sat, when naught is left to do with the hands but hold them to the fire.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo en sest, ul o valtur, doss et tolm, hosk hemm et ganna ulvenn. Um o lern re sol o ul et ganna, eth et Stonwryt ul lern et trun, dem hedh orl et movenn, amm re hyle Halyna o. Nath gyl hos o; kyle pana o. Doss Stonwryt et tolm gand tul.
english: Beside me in its niche is the stone, the old capstone of the inner gate. Face down it lay in the gateway, with its vow to the earth, till {{Halyna}} turned it at dusk on the day of the banner. It is a stone that two must turn. Its vow is sharp yet.

label: Romanisation · as Halyna say it in the living tongue
rom: Es ston et hald sy. Re hadhan o, eth tessen o, somm el tolm tolm. Ston.
english:
::: native legend_stonwryt_hal line
The Stonwryt of the first builders, on the tale-stone's underside, in their old hand, the Hal
*This wall will stand. We two laid it, and we two answer for it, while stone is stone. It stands.* It is signed under one lintel with the pair-name of {{Aldwena}}, who laid the capstone.
:::

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull rytym gor yanna lodhat ul vimm hos hosk, hosen hosk um yanna. El hos voll o, eth voll vana.
english: So write I every bonded pair, under one stroke, as a lintel on two posts. It is one name, and it is the name of two.

label: Romanisation
rom: El Halvard Tolmvard eth Rhyna Yanna Ulvenn Halyna. Re ammada Idrenna, et hemm sost, sona, eth ferre lo et gebb amm cadhat trenn venn. Nath memme Orvenna, prassyanna et hald, sona harm fedh. Hy Enrella, et tevel sost, amm cadh hos tolm hosast sodh, cadh ullen et hosk umo.
english: {{Halyna}} are Halvard Stone-Warden and Rhyna of the Inner Gate. {{Idrenna}}, the eldest, taught them, and nod by the door when a tale is laid true. {{Orvenna}}, our wall-masters, never raise their voices. Of {{Enrella}}, the youngest, the one cannot begin a jest but the other will end it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm doss et trenn tunnat, vollar o: nel brodhat, veth cadhat. Trenn sa nath gadhar veth brodhar, doss o sennet dem et ryst. Trenn sa hadhar, el saed et hald o.
english: When a tale is done we say not that it was told, but *laid*. A tale that is but told is gone by morning. A tale that is laid is part of the wall.

label: Romanisation
rom: Tess hos brod gor dhrenn lor, eth nath dess ullen fedh: Tumar.
english: Two words answer every tale of ours, and never other two: *We remember.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et vess hosast sa re vess et odh sy trenn, nath re yal brod lor. Re vysk Ebba hemm Sedhnell o ul velvyth. Re vess nahos o loy, eth re vysk nahos lor: Fenna. Veth re rik et odh et brod hyoy. Virr gor vess doss ey hosast tul, hos hoss ul lern et ullen, eth mellorar ul sestow Ebba, hosen hyll ul sestow et fodh hosast.
english: The first night this hearth asked a tale, none of us wist what to say. Old Ebba of Fenholm spake them into the quiet. None bade her, and none bade us follow. But the hearth took the words from her. Most nights she is first yet, a breath before the rest, and in behind her we come, as a tide behind its first wave.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rarr nadhumol um ol nedheth, eth re naelur nahos o. Naelurar ol dumol, hosen naelurant tolmardath et tolmath dem gethyl.
english: Forgetting came on our fathers, and none chose it. Remembering we choose, as masons choose which stones to keep.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss merr hy et trenneth sy lo et mesk, eth et saed strom hy et kaelirvesk. Nadhumant et scaevureleth, eth doss cadhol nycul ulont lo yarl. Nath noss nyculol lo et mesk, veth nath noss veskyl ludal lo.
english: Some tales are the wood's, most out of the wreck-wood. Our rolls forget, and can be made to lie. The wood cannot lie, but it cannot see fear.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rarr hos hy dholm domm. Re sol o ul et vestul ul vimm misk, ul vimm hosk Wendhessa, sa re lymme et vestul hy Dhavow Hemm ul et Ommol. Re heth gor yanna et hosk ull, dem et fedh sa re hebb et mesk lo Halyna kethyl et tolmath nawrodh sa sol lo o sest. Hy ull re hebbe Idrenna lunn.
english: One came out of a dark stone. It lay in the chest at my feet, under the seal of {{Wendhessa}}, that bare the chest out of Eldhythe at the Fall. No pair would break that seal till the wood showed {{Halyna}} what the mute stones beside it were. Then {{Idrenna}} gave leave.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath vesker et mesk, veth kether o, tunn, hosen kether tumol. Hy ull hebbe Halyna o ul saedeleth, eth grik hos ul vodh omm brodath ullen.
english: The wood is not read but known, whole, as a memory is known. So {{Halyna}} give it up in pieces, the one taking up where the other's words fail.

label: Romanisation
rom: Cadhom et saedeleth hosen ommant, ul ba luth. Nath mavere sona en rellorol cedh el cedh. Nath noss seskyl los. Galdom et trenn hy et saedeleth. Ul sestow et trenn el velvyth et odh, eth re rytym et velvyth ull.
english: I set the pieces down as they fell, in two inks. They would not have me mark whose is whose. Ye cannot tell. Out of the pieces I make the tale. After it the hearth is silent, and that silence I have written down.

label: Romanisation
rom: Mavere Halyna flenn et mesk lo yarl venn, ul lern flenn et tolm.
english: {{Halyna}} would have the wood's leaf on the right, facing ours.

label: Romanisation
rom: Trenn brodhat hy hos lern hald,
english: "A tale told from one side of a wall,"

label: Romanisation
rom: saed trenn.
english: "is half a tale."

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vodh nath re yal tul brodhol flenn et mesk, re luskom et flenn pondul, eth doss hosel meskdhrenn umo: lern yalat sa nath re hyrriler tul.
english: Where the wood's leaf could not yet be told, I have left it bare, with only the grain showing: the shape of what we understood not yet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nel hos et Lodhan en, veth re lymme Halyna en ul sona odh, hosen sullast et odh. Amm kethe sona et mesk, kethym et greller. Re hadhom en narlremull sost um et meskdhrenn hos fedh, eth re luskom. El garl sa ryt en narl, eth nel garl sa heth.
english: I am not of the Bonded, though {{Halyna}} took me into their hearth as its third. When they know the wood, I hold the lamp. Once I laid mine own palm on the grain, and let go. Mine is the hand to write, and not the hand to know.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew saed yanna gor ryterd demom. Rytym hosel.
english: Every scribe before me was one of a pair. I write alone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hunn et Crenn gor yalat, eth brodh o nayalat, eth o wiskhovv dem susk.
english: The Captain will hear all, and tell naught, and keep his hood up.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vodh re yal rytet cresket, nath re hlennym o lo haevereth. Ul vodh re navoll et Stonwrytan, re hadhom luth. Ul vodh mysk et mesk, re rytym vollath sost et mesk um yalatath, eth nel vollath orrowen.
english: Where a carving was broken, I have not mended it with guesses. Where the guild cut out a name, I have set a blot. Where the wood speaketh, I have written its own names for things, and not ours.

label: Romanisation
rom: Gor vess cadhom et trenn lo wrodhen Orrow, hosen cadh tolmard trenn, gor wrellir cresket um wrellir ul vimm. Gor wrod, myskym o ul garm sull fedh amm nath rytym o tul, dem hunnol: Ho heth o? Doss et trenn lo et brodhard; doss et brodath lom. Veskym gor flenn ul garm lo hos sa re hadh o, eth nath re vess brodhard tul o wrodath sost pawast.
english: Each night I set the tale in our tongue as masons set a course, every joint broken over the joint below. Each word I say aloud three times ere I write it, to hear whether it will hold. The tale is the teller's. The words are mine. I read each leaf to him that laid it, and no teller yet hath asked for his own back.

label: Romanisation
rom: Virr gor vess doss et brentheth sennet dem vorrdhuss, eth doss et brod dasken tul um en serr. El hosen ull, vess sy.
english: Most nights the coals are gone to ash, and the last word is yet in my mouth. So it is tonight.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vallom brodhen Orrow.
english: I love our tongue.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lymmym pa yalat dem susk et brunn, brodhen Orrow eth vestul; eth nath re yal nalelv veth et vestul.
english: Up the mountain I carried two things, our tongue and a chest; and only the chest was heavy.

label: Romanisation
rom: El luth et flennath sy. Mavere Halyna o rytyl ul gyvil et hellur sy, trenn um dhrenn, amm mellor sollan. Dem et fedh ull, sol o ul et vestul ull, ul molt et tolmath nawrodh.
english: This Book is ink. {{Halyna}} would have it cut in the granite of this hall, course on course, when peace is come. Till then it lieth in that chest, among the mute stones.

label: Romanisation · the heading
rom: Ammelyl
english: THE INVOCATION

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Mysket gor vess lo Odh Sell, ul lern et trenn hosast, eth cadhat lo sy ul lern et trenn hosast et flennath.
english: *Spoken at the Long Hearth before the first tale of every night, and set here before the first tale of the Book.*

label: Romanisation · the Title
rom: Ul dumol ol varn, ol theldeth, ol Mardh, ol lunnath, ol sollan.
english:
> ::: native legend_title_coal line
> The Title of Liberty in the course-hand, as the Captain wrote it in coal on the torn cloak
> *Ul dumol ol varn, ol theldeth, ol Mardh, ol lunnath, ol sollan.* In memory of our home, our families, our God, our freedoms, our peace.
> :::

label: Romanisation · the Title
rom: Ul dumol ol varn, ol theldeth, ol Mardh, ol lunnath, ol sollan.
english: **IN MEMORY OF OUR HOME, OUR FAMILIES, OUR GOD, OUR FREEDOMS, OUR PEACE.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Reska, amm doss lunn, eth stona amm nath noss. Brident et brammath, eth nath rhyn et lodh ul lern vess.
english: Sit, if there be room, and stand if there be none. The guns are cooling, and the mortar will not set ere dark.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss et odh lo sy, eth lo sy et tolm sa re omm hy et ganna ulvenn. Re hethent garlath mest o, eth es gethent mest. Brodh gor sa heth o amm sy.
english: Here is the hearth, and here the stone that fell from the inner gate. Many hands have held it, and many shall. Whoso holdeth it now is the teller.

label: Romanisation
rom: Cadhar et trenneth sy, hy vodh re nadhumar hos fedh. Re nadhumant ol nedheth kethow, eth re hresk o. Re nadhumant so yedheth grest, eth re vymm o demor ul vimm wemmeth myst. Hy ull cadhar gor yalat: et galdol eth et creskyl, et grest sa re yal galdat umor, eth et grest sa re yaldar.
english: We lay these tales, for once we forgat. Our fathers forgat a keep, and it crumbled. Their fathers forgat a wrong, and it came back to us under grey sails. So lay we all of it: the building and the breaking, the wrong that was done to us, and the wrong we did.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss merr hy et trenneth sy lor, trenneth rytet venn, hosen rytet tolmath et hald. Doss merr lo et mesk, eth el duss so wrodhol, eth nath byntent. Ul vodh nath gemme pana, re hether pana.
english: Some of these tales are ours, and they are cut square, as the stones of the wall are cut. Some are the wood's, and those are hard to tell, and will not be hurried. Where the two agree not, we have kept both.

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm. Cadh et trenn. Amm cadhat o, es dess et odh.
english: Hold the stone. Lay the tale. When it is laid, the hearth will answer.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Covv Treskat
english: I.1 · The Torn Cloak

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Et grem hosast, et vess ul sestow et Ternil.
english: *The first winter, the night after the Rite.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadh Kael Nydherd, ul et vess hosast sa re vess et odh sy trenn. Nath re lusk o lom kylyl hos brod hyo; re hylym mest, eth amm re veskym o lo, re ryt o: Brod um wrod ew o, hosen re wrodhom o.
english: *Laid by Kael the Counter, on the first night this hearth asked a tale. He forbade me to change one word of it; I changed a good many, and when I read it him, he sware it was word for word as he had told it.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hebb et tolm lom. Nath reskym; es stonom. Re reskym loskat grem sy.
english: Give me the stone. No, I will stand. Enough have I sat this winter.

label: Romanisation
rom: Rytom um hosk et bystir rerdsennen, sa re rytent et pardath hemm so vollath umo. Ston. El nydherd en, nel vellerd. Nydhym bisketh, eth tolmath, eth orlath. Galat sa nath re nydhym, nath gadhom o.
english: By the lintel of the western stair I swear it, where the old wardens cut their names. A teller am I, and no singer. Heads I tell, and stones, and days. What I told not, that will I not tell.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vellor et trenn ul hedh, ul vimm et ganna hyvenn. Re hunnom o amm nath re veskym o tul: misketh mest, eth nath re yal carm ulont. Hy et ganna re nydhym o, bisk eth bisk.
english: At dusk the column came in under the outer gate. I heard it ere I saw it: many feet, and no voice among them. From the gate I told it, head by head.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vellorant uldath hemm, eth essath lo havulath, eth tevath ul naedh um so visketh, eth hesperdeth vran kest cresket, sa re vammant so hrenneth. Re vellor et Crenn dasken, sa re heth o et sestow gor orl et orrol. Lesk bost eth merr lesk murr, nydhet tunn.
english: Old men came, and women with bundles, and children asleep on their feet, and soldiers of six broken companies, that knew their officers no more. Last came the Captain, that had kept the rear the whole road. Two thousand and some hundreds, all told.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re orrar bress hy vorrdhuss Sirrvell dem gethow. Re vellorar tolmstell. Re heth hos brellir et ganna, eth ul et parow re ston linth dem et gerd. Ul vodh re hadhant et velleth hellur strom, re yal et crisur ommat, eth re sol sulv um et odh sa reskys lo amm sy.
english: A month had we walked from the ashes of Glasspire to come to a castle. We came to a heap of stones. The gate hung by one hinge, and in the ward the grass stood to the knee. Where the songs had set a great hall, the roof was fallen in, and snow lay on the hearth where ye sit now.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re varrant merr. Re semment merr. Re ommant merr, eth nath re dhaldant.
english: Some shook. Some wept. Some fell, and would not rise.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re dhald et carmol, eth new hos carm. Re harmant merr: Pessa haethil dem wemmeth myst! Veth re hyrril nahos sa hoss fedh hos brod sa re vyskent. Re harmant merr: Dem et hiskenneth susk, eth et sulv ul neld! Re harmant merr: Orra dem vimm ul nyrulath, eth hoska et gebbeth, eth tovva! Hosen amm es nadhum et wadh ol.
english: Then began the crying, and it was not one cry. Some cried that we should beg terms of the grey sails, though no man living ever understood one word they spake. Some cried for the high passes, and the snow beyond them. Some cried that we should go down into the cellars, and bar the doors, and bide, as if the sea would forget us.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hunnom uldath ul greskyl ul et hollarol sell. Nath re hunnom fedh lunt ul greskyl, dem et hedh ull. El hunnat hosen crest hull ul morrol.
english: Men had I heard break, on the long retreat. Never till that dusk a people. It is a sound like ice going out on a river.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rarr et helvhoss dem vimm hy et sorth treskat, eth grem tunn ul o wrodow.
english: Down off the riven ridge came the wind, with the whole of the winter in its mouth.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vesk et lunt dem grenn hesteth, eth re yalant et crenneth hesteth hurrat. Re vesk o dem et pithulath, eth re yalant et pithulath driget. Re vesk o dem et Stonwrytan, eth re resk et Stonwrytan ul linth, eth so wresketh ul so simmeth.
english: The people looked for a general, and the generals were slain. They looked for the lords, and the lords were scattered. They looked to the Stonewrights, and the Stonewrights sat in the grass with their chisels in their laps.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vesk nahos hyont dem et Crenn. Ew crenn hest lyss o, eth ew o hest ol. Gor orl et orrol sell re dhovv o dem hos sa re yal et neskyl lo; eth re rarr nahos, hy vodh re yalant sennet. Nath hyrrila en navenn: nath re yal hos strom hyo, eth nath gaeverym re hoss fedh uld hosen et Crenn. Veth nath re vaver o neskyl. Rytom um ull. Ston.
english: To the Captain looked none of them. Captain was he of a small company, and we were his company. All the long road he had waited for one whose place it was to lead, and none came, for they were dead. Mistake me not: there was no greater man, and his equal, I think, never lived. But he sought not to lead. I swear to that.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re veskent et vennuldath dem so Hrenn. Re vesk et Crenn um et hald.
english: The True Men looked to their Captain. The Captain looked at the wall.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re yyst o. Ul et hellur re rik brenth hy et odh sennet, et odh sy, eth re sesk nahos hyor hy vodh. Re orr o dem susk um lern gask, hosel, lo dhrenn et tolmath sa re dhaldant hy et lodh. Re stonar lo visk, eth re luskar o, hy vodh nath re vysk o lor: Fenna. Re nydhym et tolmath ull hy et fedh ull: doss hosnoth eth murr, eth marrant gemm hyont.
english: Then he climbed it. In the hall he had taken a coal from the dead hearth, this hearth, and why, none of us wist. Alone he went up the broken face, by the stones that stood proud of the mortar. We stood at the foot and let him, for he had not bidden us follow. I have told those stones since: thirty-one there are, and four of them move.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo wisk re nahovv o hovv. Ew lorr o hos fedh, amm nath re hyl et orrol o tul dem vesket vorrdholm. Ul et helvhoss ull, nath re yal galat lo veth o.
english: At the top he took off his cloak. Crimson it was once, ere the road wore it to brick. In that wind it was all he had.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vysk nahos ul et parow. Ul molt et essath re hresk hoss dhev lyss, eth re hadh et odha velvyth umo. Hy ull re yal nayalat veth et helvhoss.
english: No man in the ward spake. Among the women a child coughed, and his mother hushed him. After that there was naught but the wind.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re dhresk o lo dhrenn o sestow.
english: He tore it down the back.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew hunnat lyss o, hunnat roval hemm ul villurol. Re hunnom o um et helvhoss.
english: A small sound it made, the sound of old cloth giving. Over the wind I heard it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadh o hos saed um et hoskath, eth re lumm o umo lo et brenth, eth re ryt o. Re ryt o niss, hosen rytent uldath sa nath re rytent mest. Re yal et saed ull bysket um hagess hy et gask. Re hadh o et saed ullen pawast um o sest, nayalat rytet umo.
english: The one half he spread on the capstones, and kneeled on it with the coal, and wrote. Slowly he wrote, as men write that have written little. That half he bound to a pike out of the rubble. The other half, with naught written on it, he put back on his shoulders.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hosast re fennym o dem susk, eth hosast re veskym o. Nath re varr o yarl hos fedh. Re hylym dem et parow, eth re veskym o ul garm, eth nath re ston en garm, eth nath nyculom umo.
english: First up after him was I, and first to read it. Not once had his hand shaken. I turned to the ward and read it out, and my voice was not steady, and I will not feign it was.

label: Romanisation · the Title
rom: Ul dumol ol varn, ol theldeth, ol Mardh, ol lunnath, ol sollan.
english:
::: native legend_title_coal line
The Title, as he wrote it in coal on the torn cloak: the course-hand
*Ul dumol ol varn, ol theldeth, ol Mardh, ol lunnath, ol sollan.* In memory of our home, our families, our God, our freedoms, our peace.
:::

label: Romanisation · the Title
rom: Ul dumol ol varn, ol theldeth, ol Mardh, ol lunnath, ol sollan.
english: **IN MEMORY OF OUR HOME, OUR FAMILIES, OUR GOD, OUR FREEDOMS, OUR PEACE.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadh o et hagess ul dresk et hald, eth re hebb o lo et helvhoss, eth re rik et helvhoss o. Ew ull hald nahresket dasken Orrow, eth ew ull et movenn umo.
english: He set the pike in a cleft of the wall and gave it to the wind, and the wind took it. That was the last unbroken wall of the Shorelands, and that was the banner over it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm sy hunna cedh re dhess, eth ul drenn vodh, hy vodh re nydhym so. Nel nydhyl nydhyl dem vollol.
english: Now hear who answered, and in what order, for I told them. A count is no count till it be named.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hosast re dhessent et vennuldath. Re wesk o ol hos eth hos, ul gesteth eth um orrolath, eth re heth o ol lo nayalat veth osk. Re hether ol ryteth, eth re yaldar galat sa re dhragular, eth nath re yorrar veth amm ew venn et dask. El gor yalat vennuld ull. Myskym o dem va seskyl: nel mest o. Veth nel lyss o.
english: First the True Men. One by one he had found us, in garrisons and on roads, and bound us with naught but trust. We kept our oaths, and built what we promised, and fought never but in a just cause. That is the whole of a True Man. I say it that ye may know it is not much. Nor is it little.

label: Romanisation
rom: Stannard Sorth. Corlen Dhavow. Tamm Sull Heskal. Marl Sedhen. Aske Hrisur Lurr. Garvel Runnowath. Harl Orrow sa Vorr. Ulden Salereth. Hesk Lynth. Lanner Gynten. Pellow Vell. Eth Kael Nydherd, rytvard et vennuldath; nath noss cumm lom, hy vodh re wesk et Crenn en lo orrol.
english: Stannard of the ridge. Corlen of the harbour. Tamm of the three spans. Marl the fen-born. Aske of the canopy. Garvel of the smithies. Harl of the burning shore. Ulden of the galleries. Hesk of the mere. Lanner of the crags. Pellow of the spire. And Kael the Counter, their oath-keeper, of no haven, for the Captain found me on a road.

label: Romanisation
rom: Delv. Re nydhym ol pa fedh, eth new sell.
english: Twelve. I counted us twice, and it took not long.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re dhessent et vran kest, gor vennuld hos cryrull, eth oskant ol hosen oskar o. Hy ull re dhess lunt et trenn, sa re lymm so dhevath um so sestowath lo dhrenn et hiskenneth. Hos carm. Delv. Hy ull lesk murr eth lesk murr, dem et fedh sa nath re yal nydhyl lom.
english: After us answered the six companies, a troop to each of us, and they trust us as we trust him. Then answered the people of the column, that bare their children on their backs through the passes. One voice. A dozen. Then hundreds, till I could tell them no more.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hessym. El et fedh hosel sa re hessym.
english: I stopped. It is the only time I ever stopped.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re hebb o haral. Nath re ryt o veth galat sa re yal lor tul, eth re yal loskat.
english: He gave no command. He had but written down what we had left, and it was enough.

label: Romanisation
rom: El lorr gever et Kethow sy, eth gever ol gethowath sa yaldar. El vesket et covv ull.
english: Crimson is the pennant on this Keep, and on every keep we raise. It is the colour of that cloak.

label: Romanisation
rom: Veska um rask et prenth, dhevath lo lern. Doss o ul reskyl lo ull, eth o wiskhovv dem susk.
english: Look to the end of the bench, ye children at the front. There he sitteth, with his hood up.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss et saed ullen um o sestow.
english: On his back is the other half.

label: Romanisation
rom: Mysk o los: new hosen ull. Ew hosen ull.
english: He will tell you it was not like that. It was like that.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Hy ull re vellent et vennuldath, hosen vellent o tul:
english: *Then the True Men sang, as they sing it still:*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Ganna cresket, pithulath driget,
english:
*The gate was broken, the lords were scattered,*
*the grey sails gathered along the shore;*
*one man climbed where the stones lay loosened*
*and tore the cloak his shoulders wore.*
*He wrote five things a man might die for,*
*and none of us has needed more.*

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the frame
rom: Doss hosel meskdhrenn um et flenn ul lern, eth hos trenn ul vimm:
english: *On the leaf that faceth it there is naught but the grain of the wood, and one line beneath:*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s line
rom: Nawrodhat. Nath noss tul kethyl et gunn sy lo Halyna.
english:
> ::: native legend_seren_note line
> Seren's note, in the course-hand
> Untold. {{Halyna}} cannot yet hold this deep.
> :::
